verdict.rationale: Hightouch documents Git Sync for managing workspace resources programmatically, and a company comparison cites git version control, which implies versioning and code review of syncs. The docs also mention approvals and ownership boundaries as a review mechanism. Rollback is not documented anywhere, and the Git Sync evidence is a single thin line that does not say which automations it covers (journeys, audiences, syncs). Missing for 10: explicit rollback or restore-previous-version capability, detailed Git Sync docs on what resources are versioned, coverage of journeys/automations specifically, independent hands-on corroboration.
